metadata.description:
Turn photos and text into LEGO-compatible 3D brick models with BrickBuilder AI — now with a little build buddy by your side.

MEET YOUR BUILD BUDDY
Choose Pip, the curious red brick; Nib, the clever beaver; or Clik, the imagination dragon. Describe your idea in the conversation box and follow along as your buddy responds and your build takes shape.

FROM AN IDEA TO 3D BRICKS
Start with a photo or a few words. Create LEGO-compatible brick models, explore them in 3D, and zoom in on the details.

MAKE IT YOURS
Refine your LEGO-compatible model with AI edits. Try another direction and keep building on your imagination.

FIND YOUR NEXT BUILD
Explore community creations for inspiration and discover what other builders are making.

- Three build buddies: Pip, Nib and Clik.
- A conversation box for your ideas and build progress.
- LEGO-compatible 3D models from images or text.
- Interactive 3D viewing and AI model edits.
- Community builds to explore.
